# DrillOps

> Automated Database Disaster Recovery Verification, RTO/RPO SLA Verifier, and SOC 2 CC9.1 / ISO 27001 Auditor Evidence Dossier Generator.

DrillOps is an autonomous database disaster recovery verification engine. It proves that database backups actually restore to completion *before* disaster strikes, measuring Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and compiling cryptographically signed, auditor-grade compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II (CC9.1), ISO 27001, and HIPAA audits.

## Quick Installation & Usage
- One-line installer: `curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redintDev/drillops/main/install.sh | bash`
- Interactive Sandbox Demo: `drillops demo`
- Pre-flight Diagnostic: `drillops doctor`
- Verify a Backup: `drillops verify --backup ./backups/prod.sql.gz --type postgres --tables users,orgs --out ./certificates`
- Compliance Checklist: `drillops checklist --eval --out ./SOC2_DR_CHECKLIST.md`
- Composite GitHub Action: `uses: redintDev/drillops@v0.2`

## Core Capabilities
- Ephemeral database sandboxing for PostgreSQL 16, MySQL 8.0, MariaDB, and SQLite.
- Tamper-evident Ed25519 cryptographic compliance certificates with SHA-256 data checksums.
- RTO / RPO SLA verification against custom disaster recovery policies.
- SOC 2 Type II (CC9.1) and ISO 27001 DR audit preparation dossiers.
- Continuous WAL/binlog replication stream gap analysis.
- PII & secret detection scanning (PCI-DSS credit cards, SSNs, credentials) before staging.
- Embedded dark-mode HTTP server and dynamic SVG compliance status badges.

## Commercial Licensing & Tiers
- Free / Community Tier: Single database restore drills, CLI reporting, full SQLite/PostgreSQL restore engines ($0).
- Pro Tier ($79/yr): Multi-target orchestration daemon, automated S3/R2 polling, audit dossier ZIP packaging.
- Enterprise Tier ($199/yr): Asymmetric Ed25519 auditor signatures, priority support, unlimited backup targets.
- 14-Day Free Trial: Fully functional offline evaluation token mintable directly in browser at https://redintdev.github.io/drillops/.
